title: autospec provider-neutral dispatch result
description: The §16 `dispatch(request) → result` envelope emitted by scripts/executor-dispatch.sh. Every harness returns the same key set, so orchestration never special-cases a provider. Any metric the adapter did not observe is the string "unknown" — §25 requires unknown over fabricated values, and a fabricated 0 is indistinguishable from a measured 0 once it reaches the routing ledger.

status.description: Terminal state of the dispatch. `timeout` is kept distinct from `failure` so a caller can tell 'too slow' from 'wrong answer'.

output.description: The harness's textual result. On a timeout this is the partial output captured before the ceiling was enforced. On a path that never reached a harness — an invalid request, an unsupported provider, a missing binary — it is the diagnostic explaining the refusal.

patch.description: Working-tree diff produced in the workspace, empty when nothing changed, or "unknown" when the workspace is not a git worktree and no diff can be observed.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens as reported by the harness. "unknown" when the harness reported none.

output_tokens.description: Completion tokens as reported by the harness. "unknown" when the harness reported none.

cached_tokens.description: Cache-read prompt tokens as reported by the harness. "unknown" when the harness reported none.

prompt_tok_s.description: Prefill throughput. Cloud harnesses do not measure it; they report "unknown", never 0.

decode_tok_s.description: Decode throughput. Cloud harnesses do not measure it; they report "unknown", never 0.

ttft_ms.description: Time to first token. "unknown" unless the harness reported it.

wall_clock_ms.description: Elapsed wall-clock time. Always measured by the dispatcher itself, so it is never "unknown".

tool_calls.description: Tool invocations made during the dispatch. "unknown" when the harness reported none.

failure_class.description: `none` on success. `unsupported_provider` accompanies exit 12; `timeout` accompanies exit 4.
